title: Fieldline Santa Clara
description: Explore every section at Levi’s Stadium, enter modeled seated views, compare sightlines, and inspect obstruction, shade, weather, and event context before opening official tickets.

prompt.objective: Build an object-only 3D stadium explorer for modeled seat views and sightline context.

mintAssets.brief: Stadium rails, stairs, uprights, seats, accessible platforms, and a seated crowd avatar.
Restrained loopable distant stadium crowd ambience.

experience: Browse sections, rows, and modeled chairs, then enter eight seated perspectives.
Compare obstruction, shade, event configuration, and modeled-versus-sourced truth.
prompt.visualDirection: Monumental red seating, charcoal analysis panels, lime controls, and clear source-aware data typography.
